scientific_integrity: Infinite-family result follows from projector proof and rational polynomial identities; finite exact-arithmetic tests corroborate, not replace, proof.
scientific_limitations: Endpoint map for exact-arithmetic unweighted complete multipartite graph Laplacians. No stagewise/nonlinear/roundoff positivity claim; other undirected graphs can fail, as an explicit path example shows. Complete specialized-literature exclusion is not claimed.
title: Unconditional fourth-order Gauss–Padé positivity on complete multipartite diffusion graphs
